question: Who among the following personalities has been conferred the prestigious Padma Shri Award for his contribution to Folk Dance form Panthi?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Dr. Radhe Shyam Barle__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Panthi dance is one of the important dance forms ofChhattisgarh ,State of India.
 
• This Indian folk dance is basically a prominent ritual of the Satnami community of Chhattisgarh.
 
• **Dr. Radhe Shyam Barle has made his contribution in promoting and disseminating the messages of Baba Guru Ghasidas through Panthi.**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vinayak Vishnu Khedekar** is among the 102 persons chosen for Padma Shri awards announced on Monday.
 
• **Gopal Prasad Dubey** is an Indian classical dancer, known for his expertise in the Indian classical dance form of Chhau.
 
• **Shri Ghanakanta Bora** is one of the most eminent exponents.​ 

84
